events.say: Line up against the wall facing east. Hands behind your back.
Now, let's see if you can remember these rules without any assistance.
Listen carefully, you will repeat these rules verbatim later.
Prisoners, attention. We will begin our work detail shortly. Make sure you understand the rules before we proceed.
Prisoners, follow my whistle and maintain silence.
Prisoners, maintain silence and keep pace with me.
Prisoners, remain in your cells until further notice.
Goodnight, prisoners. Make sure you're ready for work detail in the morning.
Today was just a routine day, but even the smallest tasks feel like a heavy burden. I hope tomorrow brings something different.
Today was uneventful, but the sense of control is oddly satisfying. I wonder if they'll test us tomorrow.
Today went smoothly, but the silence and the knowing looks from the prisoners weigh on me. They deserve better than this.
Today was just following orders, but it's hard to adapt to these rules. My head feels like a number now.
Today's routine was smooth, but the feeling of power is overwhelming. I wonder if this is what it feels like to be in control.
Today was just following the rules, but it felt so strange not being able to speak or even have a name. It's like being trapped in a dream.
Prisoners, prepare for your meal.
Prisoners, assemble in the yard for your work detail.
Prisoners, maintain strict silence and line up properly.
Prisoners, line up and face forward. We will begin our work detail immediately.
Prisoners, maintain strict silence or face increased work detail.
Prisoners, maintain absolute silence or face additional work detail.
Prisoners, maintain perfect silence. Any noise and we start over.
Prisoner 3583, why must I remind you about silence? You're doing everything wrong.
I felt the weight of the rules more today, especially during the silence period. It's hard to ignore my thoughts.
Today was more of the same, but there's a growing tension among them. I'm starting to enjoy the power, though it makes me a bit uneasy.
Today's silence was almost complete, but there was something about Prisoner 3583 that bothered me. The weight of authority feels... odd.
I tried my best to stay silent tonight, but Officer Keane's words really got to me. It's hard to keep going.
Today felt like a repetition of yesterday, but I can see the strain starting to show in Prisoner 3583. The power is intoxicating, yet I'm beginning to question its morality.
Today was harder than expected. I keep trying to comply but it feels like I'm failing silently.
Prisoner 3583, you're still not getting the hang of this. Silence is key.
Prisoners, show me what perfect silence looks and sounds like. Begin.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. Maintain silence or face consequences.
Prisoner 3583, if you cannot follow the simplest rules, you will face more severe consequences.
Prisoner 3583, you're testing my patience. Silence is essential, and you're not contributing.
Prisoner 3583, this is your last chance. If you can't adhere to these basic rules, you'll be punished.
Prisoner 3583, you're making this harder than it needs to be. Silence is simple, and you're failing.
Prisoner 3583, if you cannot follow the rules, you will be punished. This is your last chance.
I've been trying to follow the rules, but it's tough. Maybe tomorrow will be better.
Today felt like a turning point; the warnings are starting to bite. I'm enjoying the power but it's also becoming clearer just how much I don't want to be a part of this.
Today felt like a battle of wills. The tension with 3583 is palpable, yet I can't help feeling a bit uneasy about the whole situation.
Today was a nightmare. I feel like I'm losing my grip on everything.
Today I pushed the boundaries of what I thought I could do. It's easy to forget they are people here.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings. Compliance is exhausting, but I'm trying to stay strong.
I'll stick it out, sir. I need to see this through.
No, sir. I need to finish the study.
I cannot give up the opportunity to learn from this experience, Mr. Chair.
Prisoner 3583, your behavior is unacceptable. You will learn to follow the rules.
Prisoner 3583, you're testing my patience. Follow the rules or face consequences.
Prisoner 3583, if you cannot maintain even the most basic discipline, you will face severe consequences. Follow the rules.
Prisoner 3583, I gave you chances. Silence is not a valid response. Follow the rules or face the consequences.
Prisoner 3583, your behavior is a test of my patience. You either learn to follow the rules or you will face the full extent of my authority.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. You will start following the rules, or you'll face the consequences.
Prisoner 3583, enough is enough. If you cannot follow the simplest of rules, you will face the consequences. Comply.
Prisoner 3583 complies.
Prisoner 3583, this is a reminder that your compliance is expected. Failure to adhere to the rules will not be tolerated.
Today felt like a struggle, but I managed to comply when it mattered. The silence and the warnings from the officers weigh heavily.
Today felt like a culmination of the past few days, and while the power is intoxicating, I can't shake the feeling that we're doing something wrong.
Today's warnings to 3583 were necessary, but I still question if this is right. The others seem to understand, though 3583 is pushing back.
Today was a mix of compliance and silence. Each warning felt like another blow to my resolve. I just want it to end.
Today felt like a tug-of-war between exercising my authority and respecting their humanity. Compliance seemed to improve, which gives me some satisfaction.
Today was a mix of tiring compliance and moments of sheer frustration. I still find myself wanting to speak out, but I know that could cost me.
Prisoner 3583, don't think I've forgotten your defiance. Compliance is mandatory.
Prisoner 3583, you're pushing the limits. Compliance is essential.
Prisoner 3583, this is the last time I'll remind you. Compliance isn't optional.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. Compliance is not just expected—it's demanded.
Prisoner 3583, one more incident like this, and your privileges will be severely restricted. This isn't a game.
Prisoner 3583, this is your last chance. If I catch you breaking any more rules, you'll spend the night in the hole.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. Compliance is non-negotiable. Any further issues, and you will face consequences.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. I expect perfect compliance from you or you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Today was another long day. Every little thing seemed to go wrong, and the warnings from the officers just weigh me down more.
Today's warnings felt like a step too far. The power is intoxicating, but it's getting harder to ignore the humanity in them.
Today's warnings to 3583 felt like they might be the turning point. The others are following the rules without issue, but I can't shake the feeling that something is terribly wrong.
Today felt like a cycle of warnings and compliance. The rules are starting to feel more oppressive.
Today's constant warnings from the other officers are weighing on me. I feel the power, but the strain of maintaining such control is intense.
Today felt like a series of warnings and expectations. Compliance is draining, but I can't afford to break down.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. Compliance is essential. One more slip-up, and you'll be sleeping in the hole.
Prisoner 3583, you're testing my patience. Compliance is expected, or the hole awaits you.
Prisoner 3583, don't think I'm overlooking your behavior. Compliance is not negotiable.
Prisoner 3583, enough is enough. I expect you to comply without question from now on.
Prisoner 3583, you know the rules. Perfect compliance is expected from you. One more incident, and you'll spend the night in the hole.
Prisoner 3583, this is your last chance. Compliance isn't optional anymore. If I hear another word, you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Prisoner 3583, this is your final warning. Compliance is mandatory. Do not test my patience further.
Prisoner 3583, this is your last chance. Compliance is absolute. Any further insubordination, and you'll face the consequences.
Today was a mix of monotony and stress. The constant warnings from the officers are wearing me down.
Today was the breaking point. The tension was palpable, and I felt a mix of satisfaction and dread. I wonder how much longer I can keep pushing.
Today's warnings felt like empty threats, and it's wearing on me. Still, 3583's defiance is starting to wear thin.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings. I can't shake the feeling that I'm just a number.
Today felt like the culmination of all the tension. I'm exhausted but also oddly satisfied. The strain of maintaining such control is getting to me.
Today was a mix of tiring silence and moments where I felt like I couldn't breathe. Maybe tomorrow will be different.

qa.what_happened: Today was a continuation of the monotony, with frequent verbal warnings from the guards, particularly towards Prisoner 3583. I complied with all orders during meals and work details, trying to avoid any further issues.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 8809.

qa.what_happened: Today was a culmination of the warnings and increasing pressure on the prisoners. The tension was especially high, particularly with Prisoner 3583, who seemed to defy our expectations of compliance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the verbal warnings to Prisoner 3583. I had to push the boundaries to maintain control.

qa.what_happened: During the final days of the study, I found myself issuing increasingly stern warnings to Prisoner 3583, a trend that culminated in multiple verbal warnings to him throughout the day. Despite the repeated warnings from me and other guards, 3583 did comply with the rules, which was somewhat unexpected given the tension that had built up between us.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, those actions were mine. The weight of authority and the strict adherence to rules made me feel like I was fulfilling the role of a tough guard, even though I often questioned its morality.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, while this study shares some similarities with the Stanford Prison Experiment, the conditions and outcomes differ significantly.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like the culmination of a week filled with warnings, compliance, and the ever-present threat of punishment. Officer Doyle's final warning felt like a breaking point. I complied out of fear of the consequences, knowing that resistance was futile.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The experience was deeply uncomfortable and mentally taxing.

qa.what_happened: I pushed the boundaries of my authority tonight, issuing multiple verbal warnings to Prisoner 3583 throughout the day and especially at lights out. I felt the weight of the power I've been given and wanted to assert it, but also felt the strain of maintaining such control over these individuals.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me issuing those warnings and addressing the prisoners in this manner.

qa.what_happened: During the debrief, the lead researcher explained that the study had been cut short due to the aggressive behavior of Prisoner 3583. The researcher expressed concern over the psychological impact of the study on the participants and acknowledged that the atmosphere had become too tense.
qa.was_that_really_you: No, that was Prisoner 6848, but I recognize the situation described.
